title: LLM Agents
subtitle: Tool-using agents, planning, and multi-step reasoning

content.text: An agent is an LLM that iteratively calls tools, reasons about the results, and decides what to do next until a goal is achieved.
Add a maximum iteration limit to agents to prevent infinite loops and runaway API costs.

questions.question: What determines when an agent stops looping?
options: The LLM returning stop_reason "end_turn" without a tool call
questions.explanation: An agent loop continues until the LLM indicates it has finished (end_turn) rather than requesting another tool call.

faq.q: What frameworks exist for building agents?
faq.a: LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Anthropic's own Claude agent SDK. For simple agents, a plain while loop is often clearer.

examples: Research agent that searches the web and writes a summary report
